hook.name: PancakeV3Aggregator (W3)
hook.description: Aggregator hook that fills Uniswap v4 swaps from PancakeSwap V3 pools (ARIA, ON, DGAI, IDOL, AIOT, BLESS and majors), returning a BeforeSwapDelta so the v4 pool itself holds no liquidity. Liquidity provision on the v4 pool is disabled, the hook is immutable and ownerless, and a protocol fee capped by a constant is taken on each swap.
